args.sql:
SELECT
    o.weathprofile AS condition_name,
    AVG(s.snrratio) AS average_quality_value,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN (s.snrratio) AS median_quality_value,
    COUNT(s.signalregistry) AS usable_signals_count
FROM
    observatories AS o
JOIN
    signals AS s ON o.observstation = s.telescref
GROUP BY
    o.weathprofile
ORDER BY
    average_quality_value;
